com.vector.cfg.automation.api.testinfrastructure.published

Interface IProjectLoadRule

  • All Superinterfaces:
    org.junit.rules.TestRule

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @NotThreadSafe
public interface IProjectLoadRule
extends org.junit.rules.TestRule
    The IProjectLoadRule class provides a JUnit TestRule, which will load the passed IProjectRef before test execution and close it afterwards. This can be used as a ClassRule or Rule and it could also be used with Spock. 
     
        public class ProjectLoadRuleTest {
    @ClassRule
    static IProjectLoadRule rule = IProjectLoadRule.forProject(ScriptApi.scriptCode.projects.parameterizeProjectLoad{
        dpaFile "YourProject.dpa"
    })

    @Test
    public void testcase() {
        //In this test the project was loaded and will be closed after the test
    }
